_comment: The b0b.dev intro film, collage cut, built by scripts/build-intro-collage.py.
EVERY PANEL CARRIES ITS SOURCE, BURNED INTO THE FRAME. Each media entry names its
source page, licence and sha256. Archive footage is public domain or CC0; the
contemporary stills are public domain, CC0 or CC BY, and every CC BY tag carries
the author credit on screen, as the licence requires. The ERC-1155 frames are
the author's own films, used at his direction and labelled as such.
LIVING-PERSON FLOOR APPLIED TO SELECTION, not only to words: in a montage,
juxtaposition is implication. Faces are of the dead, in documented public acts,
or crowds in which no individual is the subject. Refused for that reason: the
2003 photograph of Bush and Rumsfeld watching Powell's address, and a 2012
hearing still with identifiable living witnesses.
SOUND: the archive films' own sound where a film is on screen, under a bed
synthesised in the build script (drone, a tick per cut, a low hit per card).
Nothing licensed from anyone is laid under the narration.
THE NARRATION is spoken live by the reader's browser (site/intro.js) and is on
screen as text. Each line was checked against the record: CORONA first
recovery Aug 1960, declassified Feb 1995; Stevenson (1962) and Powell (2003)
both presented to the UN Security Council; no stockpiles were found in Iraq.

lines.text: Nuremberg, 1945. The prosecution argued from documents, not rumour.
The record keeps arriving the same way: the Pentagon Papers, the 9/11 Commission, the Senate’s torture report.
lines.say: The record keeps arriving the same way. The Pentagon Papers. The nine eleven Commission. The Senate’s torture report.

lines.text: Show the record. Say where it came from. Let the reader test it.
Washington, 1947. A committee of Congress turned the cameras on citizens.
Now the cameras sit on poles and rooftops, and nobody has to call a hearing.
An inquiry and a hunt look the same from outside. The test: could the finding have come out the other way?
Enewetak, 1952. The capability arrives before the argument about what it is for.
So does the data centre, the drone and the supercomputer.
A document can establish a capability. It does not establish a use. Secrecy is evidence of nothing about what is hidden.
1958. The first American satellite carried a cosmic-ray counter, not a camera.
lines.say: Nineteen fifty-eight. The first American satellite carried a cosmic-ray counter, not a camera.

lines.text: The cameras came in 1960, as CORONA, and stayed classified for thirty-five years.
lines.say: The cameras came in nineteen sixty, as Corona, and stayed classified for thirty-five years.

lines.text: Now the night side of the planet is a public photograph.
October 1962. A reconnaissance photograph became evidence when somebody labelled it, and the missiles were there.
February 2003, the same Council: labelled slides again. This time the weapons were not.
The label is the claim. Check it, including every caption in this film.
1963. 1967. 2003. 2011. 2020. The placards change; the shape of the crowd does not.
lines.say: Nineteen sixty-three. Sixty-seven. Two thousand and three. Twenty eleven. Twenty twenty. The placards change; the shape of the crowd does not.

lines.text: A crowd is testimony: evidence of an experience, never, by itself, evidence of a cause.
The newsreel filmed the counter-demonstrators too.
The transcripts, 1974. The Church Committee, 1975. Iran-Contra, 1987.
lines.say: The transcripts, nineteen seventy-four. The Church Committee, seventy-five. Iran-Contra, eighty-seven.

lines.text: The inquiry always comes afterwards.
Everything in this report arrived the same way: late, in public, and on the record.
{TOTAL} documented sites. Twenty-five sections.
Every source named. Every tier stated.
The specimens it could not prove, killed on its own page.
The authority of a document does not come from what it alleges.
It comes from what it refuses to allege.
τετέλεσται — it has been completed, and remains so.
lines.say: Teh-teh-less-tie. It has been completed, and it remains so.
